content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to disable the cursor, ESC, and OK keys on the [product_name] operator panel while still allowing them on the main controller? If so, how can this be achieved?

analysis.insight_summary: The user wanted to independently disable cursor, ESC, and OK keys on the [product_name] operator panel without affecting their functionality on the main unit. The reply clarified that this level of control is not supported, highlighting a limitation in hardware input management.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the capability to separately control or deactivate physical keys on the [product_name] operator panel, without impacting the main controller's controls.
